label: Every favouring of an actual root has the value order as its formal object
paraphrase: OPEN analyst premise, attribution deferred: for every actual root r at w and every favouring profile phi such that the favouring determination of phi is a real determination of r, the formal object of phi for r (the ranking that measures r's kind of operation) is the value order v's relation v.better (STANDARD_OF_FAVOURING_1, the type ValueStandardOrder). In words: an actual root's favouring is measured by the good, not by an end content. It says nothing about whether that favouring is a natural or a rational appetite. Under the kind rule that the object of willing is the good, it follows if every favouring of an actual root is a rational appetite of that root (rationalKindGivesObject, Lean-only); that hypothesis is itself the disputed mode step at a root. In formalObjectControls row 1 it holds for a favouring that is not a rational appetite of the empty apprehension state noApprehension; that state and Lane 4's appNone apprehension relation, under which the cognition criterion fails there, are linked only by interpretation. Lane 2b's D-directed nature, whose formal object for the source is D-realization, denies it (formalObjectControls row 5).
